editorial.blurb: Pollo Express serves up vibrant, flavor-packed chicken dishes that keep regulars coming back for the freshness and care in every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order fresh chicken during regular hours (avoid Thursday specials if you're driving far), and try the quesadilla or burrito—reviewers rave about how the burrito stays toasty and structurally sound.

topDishes.note: reviewers call it the best they've ever had, with incredibly flavored chicken
toasty exterior holds structure without getting soggy, excellent consistency and flavor
